scope: Concise milestones and evidence boundaries; not a transcript or complete event log.

milestones.summary: Four accelerated Tiger Lake boots panicked after approximately 252-340 seconds with pmap_recycle_page in physical window 0x101304000..0x10131c000.
milestones.limitation: Detailed panic captures are private; root cause was subsequently resolved on 2026-11-05 via PMAPFIX.

milestones.summary: One software-display control preserved basic display and ran for approximately 62 minutes 35 seconds without a user-reported freeze; a shutdown sequence appeared in the capture.
milestones.limitation: Historical control run prior to PMAPFIX and R32-PCFIX2..R32-PCFIX25.

milestones.topic: PMAPFIX internal-boot panic resolution and R32-ELSQWAIT / R32-PCFIX2 8/8 Geekbench 6 Metal breakthrough
milestones.summary: Decoded AAPL,PanicInfo0000..0003 (d1c3e3018b832b524cd3a7df730de77428f372222540c8a42e6d29ec11b628e6) identified pmap_recycle_page at 0x101310000; reserving 0x101000000..0x101400000 (4 MiB) under UEFI -> ReservedMemory with debug=0x100000 eliminated pmap_recycle_page panics across all 25 subsequent trials. Unconditional elsqWait, GEN8_ROW_CHICKEN2 (0xe4f4=0xc100c100), CS_CHICKEN1 (0x2580=0x00020002), and hpSanitizeComputeEncoder (R32-PCFIX2, NootedGreen SHA-256 f52f0d44d304e55e95b9875adb2c198b0950578b0ce4cc07191cc534962b1a54) completed all 8 Geekbench 6.5.0 Metal workloads (25,088 encoders) with 0 GPU hangs and 0 GPURestart, deployed to internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC.
milestones.limitation: Multi-run back-to-back endurance testing was subsequently conducted in R32-PCFIX3..R32-PCFIX25.

milestones.topic: Single-Port RCS scheduler (HP-SINGLEPORT-RCS), CSFLTRK truth table, and Tiger Lake _WA_TABLE persistence (R32-PCFIX5..R32-PCFIX25)
milestones.summary: Implemented lossless Single-Port RCS Execlist scheduling (PCFIX6, 0 Port1 submissions, 0 LITE_RESTORE, 0 0x40002098 freezes, 100% clean XeNG GPUREC: reset RCS ret=1 recovery); verified 100% zero-hang Stage 1 Run 1 completion (25,088 encoders) and advancement to Stage 1 Run 2 enc=32,202+ in PCFIX14, PCFIX16, PCFIX19, and PCFIX20; verified 5/5 DualSubslices (80 EU) 0xffffffff idle completion in PCFIX16; persisted CS_DBG1=00000010 and CHKN3=00002000 across context switches via 64-bit shifted _WA_TABLE bits 0xf5f|=0x80 and 0xf68|=0x01 in PCFIX25, clearing all CSFLTRK [0x2208] cache-flush tracking bits (bits 31..1) to 0x00000001.
milestones.limitation: Full 3-run consecutive Geekbench 6 Metal endurance without a single GPURestart remains in progress.
